name: Guam
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); the Office of the Governor's site self-declares WCAG 2.1 AA

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: Government of Guam and its agencies as a Title II 'State' (42 U.S.C. 12103).

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).

requires: Federal floor: WCAG 2.1 AA for web content and mobile apps, subject to 28 CFR 35 exceptions
mobile: implied — only via the federal rule, which covers mobile apps explicitly.
procurement: No territorial accessibility procurement rule found.
enforcement: Feedback to the Office of the Governor; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: No Guam Code Annotated section or OTECH policy on web accessibility was found. Guam's population (about 150,000) puts it in the 2027 tier; the population figure was not re-verified.
